title: Measurements
description: Garment and (optional, consented) body measurements for a project. Every value is mm and records its origin and confirmed_at. A value with confirmed_at = null is unconfirmed and the feasibility engine treats it as missing.

garment.description: Flat garment dimensions, e.g. shoulder_to_hem, chest_flat_width, sleeve_length, hem_width.

body.description: Self-reported body measurements. Present only with explicit consent.

MeasurementOrigin.description: user_tape_measured: user measured with a tape or ruler following the guide. user_entered: typed without the guide. vision_suggested: proposed from a calibrated photo; not trusted until the user confirms. saved_profile: copied from the user's saved body profile.

confirmed_at.description: When the user confirmed the value. null = not confirmed.

entered_unit.description: Unit the user typed, kept for audit. value_mm is already converted.

DimensionMap.description: Dimension name -> measured value. Names are lower snake case without a unit suffix; the unit lives in value_mm.

consent_version.description: Version of the body-measurement consent text the user accepted.

MeasurementsInput.description: Body of PUT /v1/projects/{project_id}/measurements. Replaces the project's measurements and creates a new measurements_id; designs computed from the old values become stale until rechecked.

MeasurementsResult.description: Response of PUT measurements: the stored record plus server validation (units, source, required dimensions).
